newsitem.title: USA: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S SUPER-G WINNER SEIZINGER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S SUPER-G WINNER SEIZINGER.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of the winner of the women's Super-G race at the World Cup Finals on Thursday:

World Cup wins: 28, downhill-12, giant slalom-4, Super-G-12. Wins this season - downhill at Lake Louise, giant slalom at Solden, Super-G at Mammoth Mountain and Vail Other feats: Moved to fifth place on all-time World Cup wins list. Finished second this season in both the downhill and Super-G standings and is second in the overall. Saw string of four successive Super-G crowns snapped by compatriot Hilde Gerg in Thursday's final race. 1996 overall World Cup champion. Won 1994 Olympic downhill gold. Won 1993 world championship Super-G.
